import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',file)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def grid_of(h,w,bg,marks=(), runs=()):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for side,a,b,col in runs:
        if side=='L':
            for r in range(a,b+1): g[r][0]=col
        elif side=='R':
            for r in range(a,b+1): g[r][w-1]=col
        elif side=='T':
            for c in range(a,b+1): g[0][c]=col
        elif side=='B':
            for c in range(a,b+1): g[h-1][c]=col
    for r,c,col in marks: g[r][c]=col
    return g

def paint_expected(g, lines, marker_out=()):
    e=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r,c0,c1,col in lines:
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): e[r][c]=col
    for r,c,v in marker_out: e[r][c]=v
    return e

# Demo 1
x1=grid_of(29,21,5,[(4,12,6),(6,18,6),(7,16,6),(12,9,6)],[('L',3,14,8),('R',17,28,8)])
e1=paint_expected(x1,[(4,1,11,6),(18,0,19,6),(6,1,17,6),(20,0,19,6),(7,1,15,6),(21,0,19,6),(12,1,8,6),(26,0,19,6)],[(4,12,4),(6,18,4),(7,16,4),(12,9,4)])
y1=mod.transform(x1)
print('demo1 equal',y1==e1, 'diffs',[(r,c,y1[r][c],e1[r][c]) for r in range(29) for c in range(21) if y1[r][c]!=e1[r][c]][:20])
# Demo 2
x2=grid_of(9,20,6,[(2,15,2)],[('T',0,1,3),('B',14,15,3)])
e2=[r[:] for r in x2]
for r in range(1,9): e2[r][1]=2
for r in range(3,8): e2[r][15]=2
e2[2][15]=4
y2=mod.transform(x2)
print('demo2 equal',y2==e2, 'diffs',[(r,c,y2[r][c],e2[r][c]) for r in range(9) for c in range(20) if y2[r][c]!=e2[r][c]][:20])
# Demo 3
x3=grid_of(7,26,6,[(3,18,0)],[('R',0,1,1),('L',2,3,1)])
e3=[r[:] for r in x3]
for c in range(0,25): e3[1][c]=0
for c in range(1,18): e3[3][c]=0
e3[3][18]=4
y3=mod.transform(x3)
print('demo3 equal',y3==e3, 'diffs',[(r,c,y3[r][c],e3[r][c]) for r in range(7) for c in range(26) if y3[r][c]!=e3[r][c]][:20])
